# Designora — Full Documentation & Tool Specification

> Designora (https://designoraa.in) delivers instant, privacy-focused image manipulation and AI enhancement directly in the user browser.

## Architecture & Privacy Model

### 1. Browser-Native Processing (Zero Server Ingestion)
The following 20 tools execute exclusively within client execution threads using HTML5 Canvas 2D context, WebAssembly, and JavaScript binary buffers (ArrayBuffer, Blob):
- **Compression**: `/tools/compress`, `/tools/compress-to-50kb`, `/tools/compress-to-100kb`, `/tools/compress-to-20kb`
- **Converters**: `/tools/png-to-jpg`, `/tools/jpg-to-png`, `/tools/webp-to-jpg`, `/tools/convert`, `/tools/heic-to-jpg`
- **Geometry**: `/tools/resize`, `/tools/batch-resize`, `/tools/crop-rotate`, `/tools/circle-crop`, `/tools/flip-image`, `/tools/passport-photo-maker`, `/tools/social-media-image-size`
- **PDF Engine**: `/tools/jpg-to-pdf` (via jsPDF), `/tools/pdf-to-jpg` and `/tools/pdf` (via PDF.js worker)
- **Color & Metadata**: `/tools/palette`, `/tools/metadata`

**Security Guarantee**: Image files never leave the client device for non-AI tasks. Users can safely process sensitive identity documents, legal contracts, passports, and medical scans.

### 2. AI Processing Engine
Tools requiring neural inference utilize serverless worker pipelines with automatic ephemeral caching:
- `/tools/upscale` & `/tools/4k-photo-editor`: Real-ESRGAN / SwinIR neural super-resolution for 2x and 4x scale factors.
- `/tools/background-removal`: DIS/RMBG neural matting for sub-pixel boundary transparency.
- `/tools/watermark-removal`: LaMa-based inpainting for seamless background patch synthesis.
- `/tools/unblur-image` & `/tools/enhance`: NAFNet neural deblurring and adaptive tone curve contrast restoration.

---

## Detailed Tool Specifications

### Image Compressor
- **URL**: https://designoraa.in/tools/compress
- **Primary Function**: Compress JPG, PNG, and WEBP images in browser with real-time preview and quality sliders.
- **Input Formats**: JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, PDF
- **Execution**: 100% Client-Side WebAssembly / Canvas
- **Rate Limit**: Unlimited (Non-AI) / Credit-based (AI)

### Compress Image to 50KB
- **URL**: https://designoraa.in/tools/compress-to-50kb
- **Primary Function**: Automatically compress JPG/PNG photos down to exactly 50KB for job, portal, and exam uploads.
- **Input Formats**: JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, PDF
- **Execution**: 100% Client-Side WebAssembly / Canvas
- **Rate Limit**: Unlimited (Non-AI) / Credit-based (AI)
